title: Deprecate createJointTorqueLoads and jointLoadUserFunctionList of CreateRedundantCoordinateMBS, removal on 2027-01-01
author: Claude-JG
description: They are rarely used. Decided: deprecated now with a warning, one release before 2027 contains both, then #3361 removes them. Without the arguments no joint loads are created.
releaseNotes: createJointTorqueLoads and jointLoadUserFunctionList of CreateRedundantCoordinateMBS are deprecated with removal on 2027-01-01; without them no joint loads are created.
